method: Only add a relationship when a primary source explicitly identifies the person, patent, assignee, license, company or investor. Technology similarity alone is not ownership.

links.quote: We believe Dr. Hansen is qualified to serve on our Board of Directors because of the perspective and experience he brings as a co-founder and our Chief Executive Officer.
links.scopeNote: This proves the founder/company relationship only. It does not prove that a specific paper or university patent was transferred to the company.
